third_party_evaluations.summary: Vendor entry-tier technician credential validating on-site Cisco hardware diagnostic and replacement skills (tracks: Routing & Switching, Data Center, Collaboration).

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced foundational: 3. The ordered median is foundational. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Hardware diagnosis and replacement constitute an entry technical practitioner baseline despite the recorded introductory hint; zero experience, limited depth and multiple-choice testing prevent associate security standing.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Hardware diagnosis and replacement are entry technical practitioner skills, so I place CCT at foundational despite the stored introductory hint. Its low-cost multiple-choice exam and limited depth do not establish network-security delivery.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded hardware diagnosis and replacement scope is entry technical field work rather than general IT literacy. Multiple-choice assessment and zero experience keep it foundational despite the source's introductory label.
